text_block_list.text:
One day, I spotted Duramente meticulously 
warming up on the academy track.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ........Does it look that way to you?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Today, I promised to run alongside my 
senior.
Nothing less than my absolute best 
run will do.

Among all the senior Umamusume, Duramente 
holds Air Groove in especially high
regard and admiration.
Judging by how much effort 
she's putting into this...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ........That is true, but.
choice_data_list: Is your training partner Air Groove?

text_block_list.text:
Duramente's expression suddenly turned 
stern!
choice_data_list: Could it be that your legs are……

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...I've felt a slight stiffness since
this 
morning. It's not an injury, however.
choice_data_list: Could it be that your legs are...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
A respected senior is giving me her 
precious time. All I can do is get myself 
in the best condition possible.

Driven by a sense of responsibility, 
Duramente seems resolved to run alongside 
her no matter what.
choice_data_list: ...I can't help but worry about yo...
Hopefully a good run will get you ...
Hopefully a good run will get you ...

text_block_list.text:
Driven by a sense of responsibility, 
Duramente seems resolved to run alongside 
her no matter what.
choice_data_list: Then hopefully a good run will get...
Then hopefully a good run will get...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
To think that someone challenging the 
world stage would falter at this level...
choice_data_list: Then hopefully a good run will get...
Then hopefully a good run will get...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
—I heard, Dura. Did you think a change in 
plans would sour my mood?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Groove-nee.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You know your own body best.
Adjust things 
today until you are satisfied. —Tomorrow, 
same place, same time. Understood?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. I'm counting on you.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Rather than blaming me,
she cheered me on. 
—She is truly the one whose back I must 
strive to follow.

After that, Duramente silently continued 
her running drills.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...I'll bring it back. No matter what.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
—It's time for our tandem run. Are you 
ready, Dura?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Of course. I shall take it under 
advisement.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I, too, was looking forward to slicing 
through the wind together. However—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
—If the pain in your leg worsens even 
slightly, don't hide it—tell me right 
away. I respect your passion, but pulling 
a muscle will only drag things out.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Sister Groove... ...Yes, understood.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Now, get on the track.

text_block_list.name: Visiting Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Waaah...!

Showing no signs of fatigue,
Duramente ran 
alongside Air Groove, sending thrilling 
excitement throughout the track.
